segments.text:
V. 26.
Jeſus looking upon them—To compoſe their hurried Spirits. O what a ſpeaking Look was there? Said to them—With the utmoſt Sweetneſs: With men this is impoſſible—It is obſervable, He does not retract what he had ſaid; no• nor ſoften it in the leaſt Degree, but rather ſtrengthens it, by repreſenting the Salvation of a rich Man, as the utmoſt Effort of Omnipotence.
